meta.description: Air and sea transport, purchasing in China, supplier payments and personalized tracking: discover all of Union Transit's services.

hero.title: Our services
hero.subtitle: From factory purchase to delivery in Dakar, we handle every step of your import.

transport.title: Transport, from China to Dakar
transport.subtitle: Departures from Guangzhou and Yiwu.
transport.hint: Click a service to learn more.

airExpress.title: Air express freight
airExpress.description: For urgent goods or samples you need to receive quickly.
airExpress.details: Air express is the fastest option: your goods arrive in 1 to 3 days. Ideal for urgent shipments, samples, or high-value products where transit time matters more than cost.

airNormal.title: Standard air freight
airNormal.description: A reliable air service for your regular shipments.
airNormal.details: Standard air freight offers a good balance between speed and cost, with delivery in 7 to 10 days. Choose it for your regular orders, when you don't need express speed but want to avoid sea freight lead times.

seaLcl.title: Container groupage (LCL)
seaLcl.description: You share container space with other clients: an economical solution for medium volumes.
seaLcl.details: Groupage means sharing container space with other clients: you only pay for the volume you use. It's the most economical option for medium volumes, when your goods don't fill a whole container. The timeline depends on how fast the container fills up, and is confirmed with your quote.

seaFcl.title: Full container (FCL)
seaFcl.description: A whole container reserved for your goods, for large volumes.
seaFcl.details: With a full container, an entire container (20 or 40 ft) is reserved just for your goods, with no waiting on other clients. Choose it for large volumes, when groupage is no longer enough or you want a more predictable departure date. Expect 40 to 60 days.

sourcing.title: Product sourcing
sourcing.description: We look for the products that match your needs.
sourcing.details: Sourcing means finding and selecting the right product and the right supplier in China for you, especially if you don't know where to start. Choose this service if you have a product idea but no reliable supplier yet, or if you want to compare several options before committing. For good sourcing, we need: the product you're looking for and its characteristics (material, size, function...), your expectations on price, quality and quantity, and any other criteria that matter to you. This service is billed separately, on a quote basis, depending on the product and the research involved.

factories.title: Factory connections
factories.description: Direct access to manufacturers, without unnecessary middlemen.
factories.details: We connect you directly with reliable factories, without middlemen who raise the price without adding value. Useful if you want to produce in volume or negotiate terms directly with the manufacturer.

quality.title: Quality checks
quality.description: We inspect products before they are shipped.
quality.details: Before shipping, we check that the products match what was ordered: quantity, condition, compliance. This avoids bad surprises on arrival, especially for large orders or first purchases with a new supplier.

payment.title: Supplier payments
payment.description: We pay your suppliers on your behalf: Alipay, WeChat, bank transfer.
payment.details: If you send money directly to a supplier in China from abroad, you take a risk: if something goes wrong (non-compliant product, unreachable supplier), getting a refund is very difficult. We therefore recommend always going through an agent in China for payment: it's secure. In practice, you come to our Dakar office, hand over the amount in CFA francs, receive a written discharge, and we handle the payment with the supplier on the ground. We then send you the payment receipt.

consolidation.title: Small parcel consolidation
consolidation.description: Group several purchases into a single basket, for one shipment.
consolidation.details: Ordering several items from different suppliers and want to receive them in a single shipment? We offer free consolidation: we group all your purchases into a single basket at our warehouse in China, and ship them together once you give us the go-ahead.

meta.title: About — Union Transit
meta.description: Union Transit, a logistics company based in Senegal with a team in China, helps entrepreneurs, retailers and individuals receive their goods from China without stress and on time.

hero.title: About Union Transit
hero.text: Union Transit is a logistics company based in Senegal with an office in China, with a team in China and a team in Senegal. Our mission: do everything, and do it as well as possible, so that entrepreneurs, retailers, e-merchants, individuals and businesses receive their goods from China to Senegal with no stress, and on time.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.text: Union Transit is everyone's business. Without our clients, our expertise would go unseen; without us, it's a lot more stress for the client, who has to receive their goods on time. We unite and move forward together.

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.description: Solid experience in purchasing and logistics, both national and international.

seriousness.title: Reliability of process

founder.bio: PM has solid experience in sales, client relations and purchasing. He founded Union Transit to put that experience at the service of his clients.
